result:
If I could change the world in one way, I’d make it easier for people to truly understand one another—not just intellectually, but emotionally.

Most conflict comes from misunderstanding, fear, or the inability to see the humanity in someone else. If people could more readily grasp why others believe what they do, feel what they feel, and suffer where they suffer, it would become much harder to justify cruelty, exploitation, or indifference.

That kind of shared understanding wouldn’t erase disagreement—but it would change how we disagree. It would make compassion more practical, cooperation more natural, and peace less fragile.
